notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Steam Deck Support:[/b]

Added support for native Steam Deck controls.

Cards that are viewed in the deck, cards section in the glossary menu, and cards in the shop's buy/upgrade sections will now increase in size so that they are more legible.

tags.feature: - Added support for native Steam Deck controls.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

Fixed a bug where the Berserker sticker would soft-lock the game.

Fixed a bug where the Courage Under Fire sticker did not work properly.

Fixed a bug where cards would remain locked after leaving a secret area or could be used in an area where a card type is forbidden if the stash list was set to a category aside from "All".

Fixed a bug where the bestiary list would be purged when loading a save file if the player went back to the title screen from the world map and loaded their save again.

Fixed a bug where the player's health bar would not play the critical animation if the battle started while their health was low.

Fixed a bug where the game would not check if the player was near death when starting a battle with low health, preventing them from receiving the "Near Death Experience" bonus if the battle was won without taking further damage.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the Berserker sticker would soft-lock the game.
- Fixed a bug where the Courage Under Fire sticker did not work properly.
- Fixed a bug where cards would remain locked after leaving a secret area or could be used in an area where a card type is forbidden if the stash list was set to a category aside from "All".
- Fixed a bug where the bestiary list would be purged when loading a save file if the player went back to the title screen from the world map and loaded their save again.
- Fixed a bug where the player's health bar would not play the critical animation if the battle started while their health was low.

- Fixed a bug where the game would not check if the player was near death when starting a battle with low health, preventing them from receiving the "Near Death Experience" bonus if the battle was won without taking further damage.

Fixed a bug where the Berserk sticker would cause a soft-lock.

Fixed a bug where players would be able to achieve the Combo Novice, Combo Expert, and Combo Master achievements long before the requirement for those achievements has been met.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]

Reduced the power of many cards to balance the gameplay so that battles don't become too easy.

Added several new combination cards:

[b]-Power Cards-[/b]

Gash + Uppercut

Gash + Dagger

Brave Thrust + Dagger

Somersault + Dagger

Uppercut + Dagger

Sky Blade + Dagger

Sky Blade + Lacerate

Lacerate + Uppercut

Sky Blade + Dagger + Lacerate

Brave Thrust + Dagger + Sky Blade

Gash + Dagger + Brave thrust

Somersault + Dagger + Uppercut

[b]-Magic Cards-[/b]

Lightning + Lightning + Gale

tags.balance_change: Reduced the power of many cards to balance the gameplay so that battles don't become too easy.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b] 
Fixed an issue where some UI components in the tutorial panel in the settings menu would not reset properly.

Fixed an issue where the text in the item received frame would bleed out.

[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]
Increased the proc rate of the Paralysis status effect of the Lightning Blade card from 25% to 50%.

Increased the proc rate of the Paralysis status effect of the foil Lightning Blade card from 50% to 100%.
